newsitem.title: USA: Lexmark Intl board authorizes buyback.
newsitem.headline: Lexmark Intl board authorizes buyback.

text.p: Lexmark International Group Inc said Monday that its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up to $150 million of its Class A common stock.

The board has provided management the flexibility to make purchases at its discretion without a target price from time to time in the open market or in privately negotiated transactions depending upon market price and other factors, it said.

The $150 million authorization is in addition to the $50 million repurchase authorization granted in April 1996. The company has used $36.8 million of the original authorization to repurchase approximately 1.6 million shares.
The repurchased shares will be held in treasury for future use.

Lexmark International Group Inc develops, manufactures and supplies printer solutions and products, including laser, inkjet and dot matrix printers and associated consumable supplies for the office and home markets.
